Daybar can now update itself, and Settings has a new About tab.

## New

- Daybar checks for new versions and installs them for you. Choose "Check for updates…" in the panel's More menu to check right away, or turn automatic checks on or off in Settings › About.
- The About tab in Settings shows the version you're running. It links to the developer's website, the source code, the release notes, the license, and a form to report a problem. It also credits the open source projects Daybar builds on.

## Fixes

- The panel now opens 1 point below the menu bar on every display, lined up with the menus from Control Center.

## Install

This is the last version you need to install by hand. Download `Daybar.dmg` below, open it, and drag Daybar to your Applications folder, replacing the old version. From now on, Daybar updates itself. Daybar needs macOS 27 or later.

The app and disk image are signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. To check your download, compare it with `Daybar.dmg.sha256`, or verify its build provenance:

```sh
gh attestation verify Daybar.dmg --repo firatciftci/daybar
```
